title: Canine Hoist In San Francisco Bay
description: Coast Guard explosive detection canine handlers from Maritime Safety and Security Team 91105 in Alameda, Calif., and aircrew members from Air Station San Francisco conduct canine hoist operations with crewmembers from the Army Corp of Engineers Donald A.B. Dillard in San Francisco Bay, March 22, 2019. The canine handlers from MSST 91105 train frequently in rigorous environments to make sure they are always ready to deploy whenever they are needed. U.S. Coast Guard photo by Petty Officer 2nd Class John Neilson.
keywords: hoist, canine, Army Corp of Engineers, Ricky, explosive detection canine, MSST 91105, Feco, John Neilson, Donald A.B. Dillard, San Francisco
